answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. One fake is cheap, but 158 aliases need 158 independent meeting records, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Use parish councillor tenure with council meeting records as the proof: meetings attended on one council for years. Watch the lantern: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the nebula bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the ocean audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
